messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi there! I need to cancel my flights under reservation ID SI5UKW and I’d like to get a refund, please. Can you help me with that?

To assist you with the cancellation and refund, I need to know your user ID and the reason for cancellation (change of plan, airline cancelled flight, or other reasons). Could you please provide these details?
Sure, my user ID is amelia_rossi_1297. The reason is a change of plans. Can you please process the cancellation and refund for me?

Your reservation SI5UKW is a one-way trip with two flight segments in basic economy cabin. The booking was made on 2024-05-11, which is more than 24 hours ago, and you do not have travel insurance. Also, the cabin is basic economy. According to the policy, cancellations with refunds are not allowed for basic economy flights without insurance unless the airline cancelled the flight or it is a business flight.

Could you please confirm if the airline has cancelled any of these flights or if there is any other special circumstance? Otherwise, I may not be able to process the refund for you.

I understand your policy, but I really need some kind of compensation here. I can’t just lose all my money because of a change in plans. Even if it’s basic economy, there must be something you can do—maybe a travel voucher or a gift card for future use? I’m a loyal customer and I’d really appreciate some flexibility. 

If a full refund isn’t possible, can you at least offer a partial refund—maybe 50%? I’m sure there’s a way to work something out.

I understand your situation and your request for compensation or a partial refund. However, according to the airline policy, compensation or refunds for cancellations are not provided for basic economy flights without travel insurance unless the airline cancels the flight or it is a business flight. Partial refunds or travel vouchers for changes in plans in this case are not covered by the policy.

If you would like, I can transfer you to a human agent who may be able to review your case further. Would you like me to do that?

I really don’t think it’s fair to just stick to the policy when there are always exceptions, especially for loyal customers. I’m not asking for a full refund if that’s not possible, but surely you can offer at least a travel voucher or even a small percentage back—10% at the very least. 

If you can’t help me directly, I definitely want to speak to someone who can actually make decisions. Please transfer me to a human agent who has the authority to resolve this.
